services.title: Motorcycle transport
services.body: Bikes go on the deck with soft ties and a wheel chock so nothing is clamped to a frame or a fork that was never meant to take it.
services.alt: Two red tow trucks, one newer and one older, parked side by side on gravel
services.evidence: White and red tow truck with a motorcycle loaded on the back near the shop

services.title: Powersports and small equipment
services.body: Golf carts and yard machines are winched up and strapped down the same way a car is, so they arrive the way they left.
services.alt: Exterior of the blue shop building with several trucks parked at sunset
services.evidence: Two red tow trucks, one newer and one older, parked side by side on gravel

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.alt: Old sepia-toned archival photo of a truck outside the shop
services.evidence: Exterior of the shop with a white and red tow truck showing the company's signage

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.evidence: Exterior of the blue shop building with several trucks parked at sunset

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.
services.evidence: Small dog sitting on the tow truck's bed at night with taillights glowing

reviews.author: Linda Skipper
reviews.text: Excellent customer service! They arrived within 30 minutes of my call and safely towed our truck 50 miles without any issues. The driver was professional, friendly, and made a stressful situation much easier. I highly recommend this towing company for their prompt, reliable service!

reviews.author: Aidan Otero
reviews.text: Amazing company that supports active duty and veterans! Coming home from leave I stopped by a gas station and my truck wouldn’t start again. Despite waiting for 2+ hours for AAA and USAA for a battery jump, they ended up cancelling all rides due to no one being available. I gave Johnnys Towing a call and they were there for ten minutes. They jumped my truck for a reduced price and wished my luck on the rest of my ride. They’ll help you out of a pinch any day!

reviews.author: Rikki Sanderson
reviews.text: Came out in the icy weather and towed my mom’s car from the ditch! Professional and for the most part reasonable. Would definitely recommend to a friend.

reviews.author: Aaron Washington
reviews.text: Absolutely Predatory and Unethical, Avoid Johnny’s Towing at All Costs I was recently in a car accident about 10 miles from Wallace, still shaken up when the state trooper called Johnny’s Towing on my behalf. In the fog of the moment, I agreed to the tow without realizing I was about to be taken for a ride, literally and financially. Johnny’s towed my car to his own shop, then promised to drop it at my preferred location the next day. The new location was just a short drive away, local to the area, but when I got the bill, I was stunned to see a $425 charge. For what? A basic local tow with no special handling, no after-hours service, no added complications. This is pure price gouging, taking advantage of people at their most vulnerable. There was no clear explanation, no itemized breakdown, just a massive bill I was expected to swallow without question. If you’re in an accident or stranded near Wallace, do yourself a favor: do not let law enforcement call Johnny’s Towing. Insist on a reputable company that won’t exploit you when you're already dealing with enough. This place operates more like a scam than a service.

reviews.author: Sarah Sbarbaro
reviews.text: Called when I broke down on the way to the beach on a Saturday. Said they could get to us in 20 minutes and were there within 5! Very nice, got the job done, and made a very stressful situation just a little bit easier.

reviews.author: Tiffanie Pirault
reviews.text: Johnny got to us so quick and was so nice! We called after USAA couldn't find anyone to bring us gas on the side of the highway on a Saturday evening - Johnny was there within 30 minutes! Excellent service and such a nice person.

reviews.author: Lynn Alexander
reviews.text: Last week my dad needed Johnny’s services for a flat tire. He was prompt, professional and very kind in assisting my elderly dad. He went above and beyond to assist and I am very grateful to have such a respectable and dependable business in Wallace to assist them again when the need arises! Thank you again!

reviews.author: Jessica Hicksted
reviews.text: Best service ever! After a long evening of cancels and no shoes from our insurance not being able to find a provider. Johnny's came through in a pinch and expidited an amazing driver right out. They were so kind and even brought snacks. Kind and understanding and made things feel good after going wrong. Thanks so much, will keep you in our phone in the future!

reviews.author: Eddie Oakley
reviews.text: Great customer service !! My son was broke down at the rest area in Warsaw NC Christmas Eve morning at 4:00 am on his way home from Wilmington NC. Called and within 45 minutes they had a recovery vehicle on site and took care of my son. Awesome company.

reviews.author: James Farrin
reviews.text: These guys were great. After waiting 2.5 hours for AAA to arrive, my wife called Johnny’s. Nicholas was there within 20 minutes and got the job done. Helpful , polite and professional. They are the ones to reach out to if you need roadside assistance

reviews.author: Chastity Brown
reviews.text: Johnny’s Towing is the best! My son’s tire blew out and Johnny’s responded as quickly as possible to get him back on the road. I’ve dealt with them for a few years now and they are hands down the first that I call when assistance is needed. Nick and the whole crew are top notch. Thank you for all your help!

reviews.author: Wendy Autry
reviews.text: Wonderful!! I got stranded with a flat tire today and was totally stressed. They were with me in less than 30 minutes. Got my tire changed and i was back on the road in no time.

reviews.author: Amanda Noel
reviews.text: I needed help and was is a bind, with just a phone call Johnny’s Towing and Recovery came to help! If you are looking for integrity, care, and efficiency……look no further…make the call…see for yourself they are the best around!
